relations.rationale: Kai being taller than Leo has no bearing on whether Pia is taller than Leo.
Hana pointing out the bird nest directly leads to the group pausing to admire it.
Pointing out a bird nest has no bearing on reaching the summit later.
Pointing out a bird nest has no bearing on the valley view from the summit.
Pointing out a bird nest has no bearing on Kai unpacking tea.
Pointing out a bird nest has no direct bearing on overall satisfaction with the hike.
Pausing to admire a bird nest has no bearing on the sun growing warm.
The sun growing warm could plausibly prompt more frequent breaks to rest and drink water.
The afternoon sun growing warm has no direct bearing on the sky darkening and descent starting.
The sun growing warm has no direct bearing on overall satisfaction with the hike.
Taking breaks to rest doesn't preclude or ensure reaching the summit; largely unrelated to timing of arrival.
Pia's height relative to Leo has no bearing on the valley view.
Pia's height relative to Leo has no bearing on the descent starting.
Reaching the summit directly enables seeing the valley spread out below in golden light.
Reaching the summit provides an opportunity for Leo to take photographs, making it more likely.
Reaching the summit in late afternoon sets up the later descent as the sky darkens.
Successfully reaching the summit contributes to overall satisfaction with the hike.
The golden light view at the summit and the later darkening sky are sequential but not causally linked.
Leo taking photographs has no direct bearing on the group beginning their descent.
Leo taking photographs is a pleasant activity that could contribute to overall satisfaction, but is not strongly linked.
